core_obligations: Reduction to stalks: f_! is left exact by construction; right exactness is checked on stalks by the exactness theorem, so it suffices to prove the stalk formula in part (1) (proof lines 994-997).

Discrete fibre: the fibre X_{ ar{y}} has discrete underlying topological space (locally quasi-finite fibres lemma) and all residue fields equal k, so the geometric points of X mapping to the given point are exactly the points of the fibre (proof lines 1000-1007).
Stalk formula: the computation follows from the more general stalk lemma for separated morphisms, giving the direct sum decomposition functorially in F (proof lines 1008-1009).
